description.zh:
IPsec连接所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the IPsec-VPN connection is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc download-vpn-connection-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-bp1bbi27hojx80nck0000 --region cn-hangzhou
